evaluator: pycocotools COCOeval bbox; no crowd; area measured at original image resolution

quality: Approximate whole-patch boxes; technical-pass candidates only; automatic non-overlapping placements; no human semantic, placement or composite review. Validation-only exploratory results, not manually annotated HQGAN results.
